libs.name: vitepress-plugin-crosslinks
libs.title: vitepress-plugin-crosslinks: links between VitePress sites
libs.description: VitePress plugin that resolves links to other documentation sites at build time. Base URLs come from config and can be overridden per environment.

libs.name: vue-cached-icon
libs.title: vue-cached-icon: cached SVG icon component for Vue
libs.description: Vue icon component that loads Ionicons, Material Design Icons, Font Awesome, URLs or SVG literals by name, caches each icon once and sanitises the SVG.

libs.name: translatable
libs.title: translatable: i18n for DynamicForms libraries
libs.description: Connects the built-in strings of the DynamicForms Vue libraries to the application's translation function: vue-i18n, i18next or any t().

libs.name: configurable-redlock
libs.title: configurable-redlock: Redis distributed lock for Python
libs.description: Python Redis distributed lock (Redlock) with one timeout setting for wait, skip or wait N seconds, silent skip of locked blocks and lock contention statistics.

libs.name: incremental-coverage-check
libs.title: Incremental coverage check: GitHub Action for diff coverage
libs.description: GitHub Action that fails a pull request when its changed lines are not covered by tests. Merges coverage.py, Cobertura, istanbul, Clover and LCOV reports.

libs.name: db-name-to-idx-mapper
libs.title: db-name-to-idx-mapper: Redis database numbers by name
libs.description: Python library and CLI that assigns stable Redis/Valkey database numbers to names, so applications on one host never collide on a database index.
